findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, or machine-readable specification exists. The API is defined only as PHP route handling code in index.php.
findings.gap: Complete absence of machine-readable API specification. Agent tool generation requires manual inspection of source code.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all 25+ endpoints, their request/response schemas, authentication requirements, and error formats.

findings.title: Unstructured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses return {"error": "<message>"} with HTTP status codes but no error codes, retryable flag, or category classification.
findings.gap: Unstructured error responses prevent agents from distinguishing retriable from terminal errors programmatically.
findings.recommendation: Implement a structured error response format: {error_code, message, retryable, category, details[]} across all endpoints.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints use server-generated IDs (uniqid()) with no idempotency key support. Retrying any POST request creates duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency key mechanism exists. No deduplication logic. Retries create duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add an Idempotency-Key header parameter to write endpoints. Store keys in a deduplication table and return cached responses for duplicate requests.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency key support on write endpoints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: POST /api/orders, POST /api/returns generate server-side IDs with uniqid() and have no deduplication — retries create duplicate records at machine speed.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add Idempotency-Key header support with server-side deduplication table
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept an idempotency key and return cached responses on duplicate submission

findings.title: No Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: Multi-step fulfillment workflow is long-running but all operations are synchronous. No background job framework, no polling endpoints, no webhook callbacks.
findings.gap: No async support for long-running workflows. Agent orchestrating workflow has no notification mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add workflow status polling endpoint and webhook callback registration for workflow step transitions.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability exists. State changes are only discoverable via polling. No SNS/EventBridge/SQS publishing.
findings.gap: No webhook or event publishing capability for state transitions.
findings.recommendation: Add event publishing (SNS or EventBridge) on order status transitions.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) returned in API responses. WAF has no rate-based rules. Rate limits undocumented.
findings.gap: Agents have no self-throttling signal.
findings.recommendation: Add X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers when rate limiting is implemented.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application only supports session-based username/password authentication. No OAuth2 client credentials, API keys, mTLS, or service account mechanism exists.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. An agent must use human credentials to authenticate.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key authentication with per-key principal attribution, or OAuth2 client credentials flow.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication with per-key principal attribution
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth2 client credentials flow or scoped API keys with principal attribution in all audit entries

findings.title: Coarse-Grained Permissions
findings.description: Only two roles (customer/admin) with no mechanism to create scoped agent identities with limited permissions.
findings.gap: Coarse-grained RBAC cannot scope agent access to specific operations or resources.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained RBAC with agent-specific roles (e.g., fulfillment-agent, read-only-agent).

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level checks within the admin role. All operations (read, write, delete) are permitted equally once admin is authenticated.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agent to read-only operations within a resource type.
findings.recommendation: Add action-level permission checks (canRead, canWrite, canDelete) per endpoint.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No JWT, OAuth2 on-behalf-of, or token exchange patterns. Session-based auth cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No delegated identity model. Cannot distinguish agent acting autonomously from agent acting on behalf of a user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT with actor/subject claims for identity propagation.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials Without Secrets Management
findings.description: Database credentials have hardcoded fallback defaults in source code. Seed data includes hardcoded plaintext passwords. No secrets management system (Secrets Manager, Vault) is used.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credential defaults in code. No secrets rotation. No Secrets Manager integration.
findings.recommendation: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager for database credentials with automatic rotation. Remove all hardcoded defaults.

findings.title: Incomplete and Mutable Audit Logging
findings.description: Only order status changes are logged (in mutable MySQL). User CRUD, return approvals, and inventory changes have no audit trail. Log is stored in same mutable database.
findings.gap: Incomplete audit coverage and mutable log storage. No tamper-evident, immutable audit trail for all write operations.
findings.recommendation: Log all write operations to immutable store (CloudWatch Logs with S3 export and object lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND audit logging is incomplete and mutable.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require complete, immutable audit attribution. Only order status changes are logged, and the log is in a mutable MySQL database with no tamper-evidence.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add application-level audit logging for ALL write operations to CloudWatch Logs
blocker_remediation.target_state: Every write operation logs authenticated principal, action, resource, and timestamp to immutable store

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. No API key revocation, no token blacklist, no service account disable.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting the platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key management with per-key suspension capability.

findings.title: No Compensation for Multi-Step Workflow
findings.description: Multi-step fulfillment workflow (validate → assign-warehouse → pick → pack → QC → ship) has no compensation logic. Each step is independently committed with no cross-step rollback.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints for multi-step workflow.
findings.recommendation: Implement saga pattern with compensating transactions for each workflow step.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND multi-step fulfillment workflow has no compensation logic.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: An agent executing the 6-step fulfillment workflow may succeed on steps 1-4 and fail on step 5. Without compensation, the order is left in a partial, inconsistent state.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement compensating endpoints and workflow state machine tracking completed steps
blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern with explicit compensation for each workflow step, or Step Functions orchestration with error handling

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Check-then-act pattern on inventory creates race conditions with concurrent requests.
findings.gap: No concurrency controls for concurrent agent instances. Multiple agents could create orders exceeding available inventory.
findings.recommendation: Add optimistic locking (version field + conditional UPDATE) and SELECT FOR UPDATE on inventory.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting at API Layer
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. WAF has IP whitelist but no rate-based rules. No application-level rate limiting middleware.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops issuing unlimited requests.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rule and application-level per-identity rate limiting.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits or Blast Radius Controls
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. Unlimited operations per session — unlimited returns approvals, user deletions, or order creations.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on operation scope. Only protection would be rate limiting (which also doesn't exist).
findings.recommendation: Add per-identity transaction limits: max_refunds_per_hour, max_orders_per_session, max_user_deletes_per_day.

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Sensitive Data
findings.description: System stores PII (emails, names, addresses, password hashes). Passwords excluded from API responses (B1 clear). Only two roles exist with no granular data access scoping — admin accesses all PII (B2 fires). No classification metadata (B3).
findings.gap: No access control differentiation for sensitive data. Single admin permission grants access to all customer PII.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth scopes differentiating access to customer PII vs operational data.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: B1 clear (passwords excluded), B2 fires (no access differentiation), B3 absent (INFO).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: B1: Passwords are excluded from /api/admin/users response via explicit SELECT. B2: Only two roles exist (customer/admin) with no granular data scoping — admin accesses all PII fields across all endpoints. B3: No formal classification metadata.

b1.reasoning: Passwords excluded from API responses via explicit column SELECT in user listing.

b2.reasoning: Only two roles (customer/admin). Admin role accesses all customer PII (name, email, address) with no scope differentiation.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, sensitivity tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Pagination or Filtering on List Endpoints
findings.description: All list endpoints return unbounded result sets. No pagination parameters, no filtering, no sorting options.
findings.gap: Agents receive all records regardless of need, potentially exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Add cursor-based pagination and filter parameters to all list endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Input Validation Without Structured Errors
findings.description: Minimal validation exists (emptiness checks, stock availability). No systematic schema validation, no type checking, no format validation. Validation errors are unstructured.
findings.gap: No systematic input validation at the API boundary. Malformed payloads not rejected with field-level errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON schema validation on all request bodies with structured error responses.

findings.title: Timestamps Without Timezone Normalization or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Database schemas have created_at/updated_at fields. Timestamps generated with PHP date() in server timezone. No UTC normalization, no Cache-Control or freshness headers.
findings.gap: No timezone normalization and no freshness signaling in API responses.
findings.recommendation: Normalize all timestamps to UTC. Add Cache-Control and Last-Modified headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs or Error Responses
findings.description: PHP error logging enabled with no PII scrubbing. Exception messages from PDO (potentially containing SQL with user data) are logged and exposed to callers in error responses.
findings.gap: No PII redaction in application logs or error responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement custom error handler that strips PII from log messages. Return generic error codes to API consumers.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or monitoring. No null rate tracking, duplicate detection, or freshness SLAs.
findings.gap: Cannot assess data completeness or reliability for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Add basic data quality checks (null rate monitoring on critical fields).

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema versioning, no breaking-change detection, no formal migration system. Schema evolution uses ad-hoc CREATE IF NOT EXISTS and ALTER TABLE.
findings.gap: API changes would break agent tool bindings silently with no detection mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add API versioning (URL prefix or header) and breaking-change detection to CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or data dictionary. Database schemas defined only in init_db() function within index.php.
findings.gap: No external documentation of the data model. Building agent tools requires reading source code.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model (9 tables, relationships, field semantics) in a schema file.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, or tracing. No structured JSON logging, no correlation IDs. Basic PHP error_log only.
findings.gap: Cannot trace agent-initiated requests through the system.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry SDK for PHP with structured JSON logging and request_id correlation.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configured for application error rates or latency. RDS Enhanced Monitoring exists but no CloudWatch Alarms for API-level metrics.
findings.gap: API degradation undetected until agents fail.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch Alarms for 5xx error rate > 5% and P95 latency > 2s.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. Only infrastructure-level observability (WAF CloudWatch metrics, RDS Enhanced Monitoring, VPC Flow Logs).
findings.gap: Cannot measure business impact of agent interactions.
findings.recommendation: Add custom CloudWatch metrics for business KPIs: orders_fulfilled_per_hour, fulfillment_time, return_rate.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance Incomplete
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists (comprehensive template covering VPC, RDS, App Runner, WAF, ECR, KMS). However, no CI/CD pipeline enforces peer review on IaC changes, and no drift detection is configured.
findings.gap: IaC present (1/3 sub-checks) but change review enforcement and drift detection absent (2/3 fail).
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with CloudFormation linting and AWS Config drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via deploy.sh (docker-compose build and up). No automated testing in pipeline.
findings.gap: API-breaking changes cannot be detected before production deployment.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing and OpenAPI spec comparison.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No automated rollback mechanism. deploy.sh runs docker-compose up with no rollback. ECR retains previous images but no automated rollback strategy.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments automatically.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with App Runner or automatic rollback on health check failure.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No test files exist. No test framework installed. No test directories, suites, integration tests, or contract tests.
findings.gap: Zero automated test coverage. API behavior changes caught by nothing.
findings.recommendation: Add PHPUnit test suite with API integration tests covering all endpoint contracts.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: Application exposes 25+ REST endpoints under /api/ prefix with JSON responses. Integration does not require direct DB access or UI automation.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All API responses use structured JSON format with Content-Type: application/json. Well-suited for LLM consumption.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: System exposes current state via GET endpoints for orders, products, order history, and pending-fulfillment with status fields.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service has no external dependencies (calls other services or external APIs). All data is self-contained in MySQL.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service is not P0 priority and not on a documented critical path.

evaluations.title: Draft/Pending State
evaluations.reason: System has pending/draft states: orders progress through validated (requires explicit approval), returns go to pending_review before admin approval.

evaluations.title: Configurable Approval Gates
evaluations.reason: QC auto-pass threshold is configurable (0-100%), QC strictness is configurable (standard/high/expedited), and workflow steps require explicit human action.

evaluations.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
evaluations.reason: docker-compose.yml provides complete local environment with MySQL and seed data. Production-equivalent data shape.

evaluations.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
evaluations.reason: No evidence of specific jurisdictional data residency requirements. US-focused e-commerce app with single-region deployment. No GDPR/HIPAA/LGPD references.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: All field names are human-readable and semantically meaningful: customer_name, shipping_address, total_amount, stock_quantity. No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: RDS StorageEncrypted: true, ECR uses KMS with customer-managed key, VPC Flow Logs encrypted with KMS. All persistent stores encrypted at rest.

items.summary: Resolve all 4 BLOCKERs (machine identity, audit logging, idempotency, compensation) and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings (permissions, rate limiting, concurrency, PII protection).
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY items and RISK-QUALITY findings that improve agent integration quality — API specification, structured errors, observability, and CI/CD.
Address INFO-level findings and remaining quality improvements — event emission, test coverage, business metrics, and documentation.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity authentication (API keys or OAuth2 client credentials)
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is the foundational blocker — audit logging, identity suspension, and scoped permissions all depend on it.

recommended_actions.action: Add idempotency key support to write endpoints
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents duplicate record creation on agent retries — critical data integrity control for write-enabled agents.

recommended_actions.action: Implement saga pattern for multi-step fulfillment workflow
recommended_actions.rationale: Multi-step workflow without compensation leaves orders in partial states when failures occur mid-sequence.

recommended_actions.action: Add immutable audit logging for all write operations
recommended_actions.rationale: Required for compliance and forensics when write-enabled agents operate autonomously.

recommended_actions.action: Implement rate limiting and transaction limits
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents runaway agent loops from overwhelming the system or causing unbounded business impact.
